notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.3 : Better Joining Process for Multiplayer Lobbies
notes.notes: [p]pushed an update to demo to hopefully help users trying to join multiplayer games. [/p][list][*][p]basically you get better visibility on joining multiplayer games. [/p][/*][*][p]Game doesn’t freeze and you get some text about what’s going on while you are trying to join. [/p][/*][*][p]It times out after 30s so you don’t get stuck. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]This won’t actually make joining faster but it does let the player know that the game is trying to join instead of just freezing up.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]I fixed some other issues like[/p][list][*][p]made the tree colliders in Mellow Meadows much smaller[/p][/*][*][p]swirly sands putt putt hole 5 : ball could go in water after going in the hole.[/p][/*][*][p]swirly sands hole 15 : water now has a drop zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Some dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Trick Shot Tommy's Shaping challenge in mellow meadows has been changed a bit too.[/p][/*][*][p]Probably other minor things I forgot lol[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER IS HERE! Grab 8 friends and play some Gowf!
notes.notes: [p][/p][h1]Multiplayer Quick Notes[/h1][list][*][p]Multiplayer is here and with it comes with 4 modes: 2 non-team modes and 2 team modes[/p][list][*][p]Stroke play : just normal golf, every man for himself.[/p][/*][*][p]Alt shot (a.k.a four ball) : basically team stroke play. You and a teammate take turns hitting the same ball until it's in the hole. 2v2v2v2[/p][/*][*][p]Speed golf : just normal speed golf, every man for himself.[/p][/*][*][p]Team Speed golf : you and a teammate take turns hitting the same ball, but go fast. 2v2v2v2[/p][/*][*][p]more modes planned for final release[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]You can only invite friends and join through steam for now.[/p][list][*][p]In game invite / join is planned for final release[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]The host chooses the game settings[/p][list][*][p]Character skill level. As of right now, all players are given equal stats based on this option. Options range from Decent to Legendary.[/p][/*][*][p]Game Mode (4 modes available)[/p][/*][*][p]Course (2 courses available)[/p][/*][*][p]Allow Carts on Greens (Speed Golf Specific option) : Having carts on the greens can be annoying because they can block putts and shots, so i added an option that essentially yeets your cart if you drive it on the green. Always feel free to leave this on and allow people to block putts lol.[/p][/*][*][p]Cart + Cart Collision (Speed Golf Specific option) : Allow Vehicles to hit each other with some force. Leave off if you don't like it.[/p][/*][*][p]Cart + Player Collision (Speed Golf Specific option) : Allow Vehicles to hit players. This basically knocks players out for a few seconds. Leave off if it gets annoying getting ran over by friends.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]The Lobby/Free Play[/h1][list][*][p]The lobby is essentially a free play area until the host starts a game. There are basically 3 areas to play in while waiting on people to join or for the host to start the game[/p][list][*][p]Towp Gowf (unfinished) : will be an area where players can compete to hit targets in a driving range. players can configure wind conditions/weather, and other options to spice it up.[/p][/*][*][p]Cart Park : Golf carts and buggies will spawn here. You can drive them in what is basically a skate park with half pipes, big jumps, a racetrack (unfinished), and other fun things to just drive your cart on.[/p][/*][*][p]Chip n' Putt area : basically just a practice area to work on chipping and putting.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]I would love your feedback![/h1][p]First and foremost let me just start by saying that if you see anything that seems wrong please let me know. Testing multiplayer as a solo dev has been a bit awkward. I did manage to get a few play-tests with friends to actually stress test things, but i am still expecting some bugs for sure. I did my best to squash as much as i could, but no doubt some got through![/p][p][/p][h1]Other Updates[/h1][list][*][p]That's all the multiplayer specific things. Let's get into other things[/p][list][*][p]Vehicles now have [b]boost[/b]. You get 100 boost. It refills after each hole in speed golf. Everywhere else it regenerates over time automatically.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]overhead view[/b] when playing golf, got rid of the free cam.,[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the way cosmetics are unlocked. Previously you had to buy them, but in the end i decided to only make equipment that can alter stats be bought, while Clothes/cosmetics are now unlocked by completing side quests.[/p][/*][*][p]I think [b]ultra wide aspect ratio[/b] should be good to go [b](21:9, NOT 32:9!!)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]I've been working on a way to make characters more feminine, so I added a muscle slider to character customization (more clothing, eye, hair etc. options coming soon)[/p][/*][*][p]I changed the way eyes work behind the scenes, making them faster to create and easier to maintain. Also removed/added some eyes, will be adding much more soon[/p][/*][*][p]You can redo shots from the pause menu (this is not a mulligan, but gives you the choice if you would rather just hit it again rather than play where the shot landed)[/p][/*][*][p]What feels like a million bug fixes lol[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.8 is live!
notes.notes:
I've been working very hard on this new update that brings the demo to a point to where I can call 'complete'.
From here on out, for the most part, I will be working on the 1.0 version of the game, mostly focusing on finishing the rest of the courses for Adventure Mode.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cOH4nKkDy44]New Trailer[/url] 

[h1]Changelog[/h1][b]General[/b]
[code]- Optimizaiton pass
- Loading Screen Rework. Includes game tips/hints, gowf/golf facts, loading progress bar
- Lots of UI fixes (mainly for gamepad)
- Fixed a bug where the user's feedback wasn't coming through on bug reports
- Fixed Invert Y settings
[/code]
[b]Golf Mode[/b]
[code]- You can now hit a shot with either LMB OR space Bar when using keyboard and mouse (in the past was only space bar)
- Refine Approach and Chip shot logic (still need to Refine animations though)
- Added Rain in Mellow Meadows (15% chance of rain)
- Added "Nice On" when you get a GIR (green in regulation)
- Added crowd noises when you do a good thing
- Added OB (can't hit ball off of map now)
- Added drop zones for water hazards
- Updated the visuals of the arrow above the ball (was very blurry and gross before)
- Added a few QoL updates where power is auto adjusted for the player on new shot or when switching clubs
- Fast Forward is now much faster if held longer
[/code]
[b]Adventure Mode[/b]
[code]- Added an intro cutscene
- You can re-play all quests and tournaments even if you have completed them previously (will not get xp/coins if already completed)
- Updated the mellow meadows pro shop to be more balanced at that point in the game
- Added 2 treasure chests, and updated all items within chests to be more balanced at that point in the game
- Updated all coin and xp gain from completing quests in mellow meadows to be more balanced at that point in the game
- Added a few new animations for NPCs
- All NPCs have speech bubble or exclamation point if you can talk to them
- Fixed level load initialization bugs
- Fixed UI bug in color panel for clothing when using controller
- Fixed bug where loading into the course grounds after a quest or tournament didn't load a conversation when it needed to
- Fixed bug where side quest popup text would transition incorrectly
[/code]
[b]Speed Golf[/b]
[code]- Added shot tracer to find ball easier
- Added Swimming (hole 2 and 3 on speed golf shows this)
- Added OB (can't drive cart out of map)
- Can't drive cart in water hazards
- Fixed bug where player avatar wasn't set properly when switching to golf cart
- A couple of other blocking bugs
[/code]
[b]Target Challenge Quests[/b]
[code]- Updated UI after a shot to reflect the zone you land in
[/code]
